question: Where was the semi-final match of the Women’s ODI World Cup 2025, in which India defeated Australia to script the highest successful run chase in Women’s ODI history, held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DY Patil Stadium, Navi Mumbai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India created history by defeating Australia in the semi-final of the Women’s ODI World Cup 2025 held at DY Patil Stadium, Navi Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The hosts chased down a massive target of 339 runs, setting a record for the highest successful run chase in Women’s ODI history.
 
• **Player of the Match:** Jemimah Rodrigues (127* off 134 balls).
 
• **India’s chase of 339 runs** is now the highest in Women’s ODI history.
 
• **Rodrigues’ innings** became one of the top individual scores in World Cup knockouts.
 
• The win propelled India to the Women’s ODI World Cup 2025 Final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Opponent:** Australia – the most successful team in Women’s World Cup history.
 
• **Venue:** DY Patil Stadium, Navi Mumbai.
 
• **Historic Record:** Highest successful run chase in Women’s ODI history (339 runs).
 
• **Significance:** India reached the final after defeating seven-time champions Australia.
